digest.component_or_area: git push core and workflow execution
propositions: Two separate YAML CAS push loops in reconcile-bridge.yml and reconcile-bridge-canary.yml duplicate logic already present in push.py with diverging fixes and retry budgets (5 vs 3)

The reconciler's best-effort disposition silently loses commits on merge-clean without final push (4c4f defect 2), while YAML has five retries plus final push; strict mode must fail loud on every silent return to prevent data loss

Moving the commit-back logic from YAML into a new core entrypoint commit_and_push_tickets_branch requires unconditional delegation to push_tickets_branch and explicit author identity passing to preserve authorship records
Strict mode must reject configuration contradictions (sync.push=off or async) immediately with a named exception, emit no BRIDGE_ALERT event, and exit non-zero only at the private module CLI boundary

All existing callers (event_append, batch_write, import_ndjson, transition_close, delete, compact, claim) must inherit the durability correction (five merge/retry cycles plus final push) while remaining best-effort by default

Both inline standing-decision blocks (reconcile-bridge.yml:285 and reconcile-bridge-canary.yml:14-19) and the canary_bridge.py docstring must be updated to reverse their prior objections to extracting the loop
